summary: Request: temporary on-prem GPU access for experimental benchmarking
description:
Request: temporary access to an on-prem GPU node (single A100 or equivalent) for 48 hours to run micro-benchmarks and a short ablation on quantized kernels.

Context: The applied-ml team wants to validate a small set of inference kernels and quantization profiles against our internal network-attached storage to collect realistic I/O and KV-cache behavior. This is exploratory — results will determine whether we open a larger resource request.

Impact: Low platform impact expected. The workload is single-node, short-lived (<=48h), and non-production. We only need network access to the internal artifact store and a service account with read-only access to a small S3 bucket.

Requested resources and constraints:
- GPU: 1 x A100 (or equivalent, e.g., A30)
- Duration: up to 48 hours (start/end window TBD between Mar 14-21)
- Images: internal benchmarking container (we can provide the image tag)
- Network: access to internal artifact store + outbound internet restricted to package registries only
- Data sensitivity: only synthetic and stripped-down model shards; no customer data

Desired outcome: Provision a temporary host with the above constraints or advise on an approved self-serve path (e.g., queue, reservation, or ephemeral job template). If provisioning is not possible, a walkthrough of a safe alternative (sandboxed cloud ephemeral instance) is fine.

Attachments/links: I will attach the container image tag and a short runbook once triaged.

Requested owner: infra or private-deployments oncall to triage and advise.
